standing_orders.text: Default Tang Manor assignment is the populated city and interior defensive belt behind the outer perimeter and before the Inner Citadel. Sword Manor remains a standing troop-house command inside the House Tang Grand Field Army and may reinforce other sectors when ordered.

organizational_state.reserve_doctrine: Preserve surviving Units and officer cadres; casualty losses change strength, not durable rank. Consolidation, dissolution, reassignment and promotion require deliberate authority.
organizational_state.staffing_policy: Attach only exact physically available formations or intact nested armies under lawful authority; prefer delegation rather than flattening large subordinate commands.
